I’m of the opinion that if you take a small position in $Doge - as of this very moment - you’d probably generate a 100% return over (within)  the next quarter. 

PS - Nothing I say constitutes financial advice.

As of the time of my tweet, $Doge was 16 cents, now the market values it at 27 cents (69% higher) - there are two months left my quarter, and I reckon we will get there. 

Thankfully, my analysis counts for nothing, as I’m not holding a position in this.
